summary: Corporate human capital development consultant with over 20 years empowering HR teams and organizations across corporate, hospitality, and educational sectors. My work focuses on building leadership capability and the interpersonal skills that determine how well modern teams actually function together. Alongside corporate L&D consulting, I design and deliver programs on life skills for work and life — a social and behavioral skills program for schools and families, Inner Bloom for adolescent psychological growth, and women's empowerment tracks under a national presidential initiative.
